raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted “tallest outside North America” as a change in the overall world’s tallest building, concluding the successor was the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur (1998). The task actually asked for the immediate successor to One Raffles Place as the tallest outside North America, which was the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong in 1989. This conflation led to the wrong city.
